description: Source code for managing user equipment (UE) bearers, including connection, disconnection, and creation of Data Radio Bearers (DRBs) and Signaling Radio Bearers (SRBs) in a 5G/4G network context.

classes.name: du_srb_connector
classes.description: Handles connection and disconnection of Signaling Radio Bearers (SRBs) between RLC, F1-C, and MAC layers.

classes.name: du_ue_srb
classes.description: Represents a UE Signaling Radio Bearer with stop functionality.

classes.name: du_drb_connector
classes.description: Handles connection and disconnection of Data Radio Bearers (DRBs) between RLC, F1-U, and MAC layers.

classes.name: du_ue_drb
classes.description: Represents a UE Data Radio Bearer with stop functionality.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connections between RLC, F1, and MAC layers for SRBs or DRBs.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates connections between RLC, F1, and MAC layers for SRBs or DRBs.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the SRB or DRB, disconnecting all associated interfaces.

methods.name: create_drb
methods.description: Creates a new Data Radio Bearer (DRB) with associated F1-U, RLC, and MAC entities based on provided configuration.
